item.title: Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
item.dc:creator: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
item.description:
Attackers have begun exploiting a maximum-severity vulnerability in the Bricksforge WordPress plugin that makes it possible to achieve remote code execution without authentication.

The post Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE appeared first on The Hacker News.
item.content:encoded: Attackers have begun exploiting a maximum-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-106733) in the Bricksforge WordPress plugin that makes it possible to achieve remote code execution without authentication.

item.title: CyberXero Uses Claude Code in Campaign That Stole Over 628,000 Ukrainian Records
item.dc:creator: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
item.description: A threat actor tracked as CyberXero used an AI coding agent to build tooling for a data theft campaign against Ukrainian organisations, exfiltrating more than 628,000 records.

item.title: Researchers Publish Working Exploit for Pre-Auth AnyDesk Linux Flaw That Gives Root Access
item.dc:creator: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
item.description: Security researchers released a proof-of-concept exploit for an authentication bypass in the AnyDesk Linux client that leads to root access.
